name: scorezilla-mcp
description: Add a global leaderboard to your game by asking Claude Code or Cursor. ~5 KB SDK, zero dependencies.
long_description:
Official MCP server for [Scorezilla](https://scorezilla.dev), hosted leaderboards for indie, browser and AI-built games.

Ask your assistant to "add a leaderboard to this game" and it creates the game and board, then pastes ready-to-run SDK code into your project. The SDK it wires in is ~5 KB gzipped with zero runtime dependencies.

Eleven tools: five read-only (`list_games`, `list_boards`, `get_keys`, `get_board_top_n`, `get_sdk_snippet`) and six that write (`bootstrap_leaderboard`, `create_game`, `create_board`, `mint_key`, `update_board_config`, `update_game_config`). Pass `--read-only` to register only the read tools.

Needs a free Scorezilla account: sign up at dashboard.scorezilla.dev, open **MCP tokens** and create a token.

tools.name: list_games
tools.description: List the games on your Scorezilla account.

tools.name: list_boards
tools.description: List the leaderboards under a game.

tools.name: get_keys
tools.description: Get a game's public key and secret-key prefix.

tools.name: get_board_top_n
tools.description: Read the top entries on a leaderboard.

tools.name: get_sdk_snippet
tools.description: Get ready-to-paste integration code for a board.

tools.name: bootstrap_leaderboard
tools.description: Create a game and its first board in one call, with SDK code.

tools.name: create_board
tools.description: Add a leaderboard to an existing game.

tools.name: mint_key
tools.description: Mint a fresh public/secret key pair for a game.

tools.name: update_board_config
tools.description: Change a board's score bounds and retention.

tools.name: update_game_config
tools.description: Set a game's allowed browser origins.
